articles.summary: NEW YORK – November 5, 2026 – Tradeweb Markets Inc. (Nasdaq: TW), a global leader in electronic trading across asset classes, today reported total trading volume for the month of October 2026 of $78.9 trillion (tn). Average daily volume ("ADV") for the month was $3.6tn, an increase of 26.3 percent (%) year-over-year ("YoY").
articles.title: Tradeweb Reports October 2026 Total Trading Volume of $78.9 Trillion and Average Daily Volume of $3.6 Trillion
